name: Managerial Skills
excerpt: Managerial skills include technical, conceptual, and human skills.
notes: Managerial skills are essential for effective management and include technical skills, conceptual skills (analytical thinking), and human skills (interacting well with people).
context_summary:
- Includes technical, conceptual, and human skills.
- Technical skills are essential for effective management.
- Conceptual skills involve analytical thinking.
- Human skills focus on interacting well with people.
